title: Webview Host Integration
summary: This module integrates the web-based user interface with the native host application, providing core APIs for webview management, platform-specific rendering engines, and CGO bindings for Go application interaction. It enables seamless communication and control between the native environment and the embedded web content.

nodes.label: Webview Core API
nodes.title: Core Webview API
nodes.description: Provides the fundamental interface for managing the webview's lifecycle, UI properties, and executing JavaScript, abstracting platform specifics.

nodes.label: Platform-Specific Engines
nodes.title: Platform Webview Engines
nodes.description: Contains the concrete implementations for rendering web content on different operating systems (e.g., GTK WebKit, Cocoa WKWebView, Win32 Edge WebView2).

nodes.label: CGO Bindings
nodes.title: Go-Webview CGO Bridge
nodes.description: Facilitates communication between the native Go application and the embedded webview, allowing Go functions to be called from JavaScript and vice-versa.

nodes.label: Native Host Application
nodes.title: Native Go Application
nodes.description: The main application written in Go that embeds and controls the webview, providing native functionalities and managing the overall application lifecycle.

nodes.label: Web-based UI Frontend
nodes.title: User Interface Frontend
nodes.description: The web content (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) rendered inside the webview, providing the interactive graphical user interface to the user.

nodes.label: Operating System APIs
nodes.title: OS System Services
nodes.description: Low-level operating system functions and services used for window management, display settings (like DPI), and other system-level interactions.

nodes.label: Underlying Webview Runtimes
nodes.title: Browser Engine Runtimes
nodes.description: The actual browser rendering engines (e.g., WebKit, Chromium's WebView2) that power the embedded webview, responsible for parsing and displaying web content.

groups.label: Webview Control Layer
groups.title: Core Webview Control
groups.description: This layer provides the high-level API for managing the webview's behavior, content, and interaction with the host application. It abstracts away platform-specific details.

groups.label: Platform Abstraction Layer
groups.title: Platform-Specific Rendering
groups.description: This layer contains the concrete implementations of webview rendering engines tailored for different operating systems, ensuring native performance and integration.

groups.label: Host Integration Layer
groups.title: Native Host Communication
groups.description: This layer handles the bidirectional communication bridge between the native Go application and the JavaScript context running within the webview, enabling seamless interaction.
